title: Not satisfied
text: Not satisfied. I received my bottle and everything works as advertised. However, I did not receive the carabiner shown in the photos. I would give 5 stars. It also seems that someone opened my FUNUS labeled package and resealed it with Amazon logo labels. It appears someone stole the carabiner from my bottle. I expect to get what I paid fully for.
